snippet.title: PlayStation - Lightning Legend - Daigo no Daibouken (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Lightning Legend: Daigo no Daibouken is an Action game, developed by KCET and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 1996.
